name: Autocomplete
description: Gray inline suggestions as you type, powered by the AI provider you choose: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama or any compatible API.

settings.title: Enabled
settings.description: Turn inline suggestions on or off. The Autocomplete panel and the status bar item do the same.

settings.title: Provider format
settings.description: Set by the provider you pick in the Autocomplete panel.

settings.title: Base URL
settings.description: Set by the provider you pick in the Autocomplete panel, where the API key is kept too.

settings.title: Model
settings.description: A fast model works best: answers slower than 1.8 seconds are dropped. Change it in the Autocomplete panel.

settings.title: Max tokens
settings.description: Longest suggestion to request. The default suits most code.

cover.alt: The plugin name, Autocomplete, beside a code editor where gray suggested code follows the cursor and a Tab key hint shows how to accept it

screenshots.alt: A TypeScript function where a gray suggestion follows the cursor, with a Tab key hint beside it
screenshots.caption: A gray suggestion at the cursor. Tab accepts it.
